text_en: Now the Lord said to Abram, “Go from your country and your kindred and your father’s house to the land that I will show you.
text_cn: 上主对亚巴郎说：“离开你的故乡、你的家族和父家，往我指给你的地方去。

text_en: I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you, and make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
text_cn: 我要使你成为一个大民族，我必祝福你，使你成名，成为一个福源。

text_en: I will bless those who bless you, and the one who curses you I will curse; and in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed. ”
text_cn: 我要祝福那祝福你的人，咒骂那咒骂你的人；地上万民都要因你获得祝福。”

text_en: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
text_cn: 亚巴郎遂照上主的吩咐起了身，罗特也同他一起走了。亚巴郎离开哈兰时，已七十五岁。

text_en: Abram took his wife Sarai and his brother’s son Lot, and all the possessions that they had gathered, and the persons whom they had acquired in Haran; and they set forth to go to the land of Canaan. When they had come to the land of Canaan,
text_cn: 他带了妻子撒辣依、他兄弟的儿子罗特和他在哈兰积蓄的财物，获得的仆婢，一同往客纳罕地去，终于到了客纳罕地。

text_en: Abram passed through the land to the place at Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.
text_cn: 亚巴郎经过那地，直到了舍根地摩勒橡树区；当时客纳罕人尚住在那地方。

text_en: Then the Lord appeared to Abram, and said, “To your offspring I will give this land. ” So he built there an altar to the Lord , who had appeared to him.
text_cn: 上主显现给亚巴郎说：“我要将这地方赐给你的后裔。”亚巴郎就在那里给显现于他的上主，筑了一座祭坛。

text_en: From there he moved on to the hill country on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; and there he built an altar to the Lord and invoked the name of the Lord .
text_cn: 从那里又迁移到贝特耳东面山区，在那里搭了帐幕，西有贝特耳，东有哈依；他在那里又为上主筑了一座祭坛，呼求上主的名。

text_en: And Abram journeyed on by stages toward the Negeb.
text_cn: 以后亚巴郎渐渐移往乃革布区。

text_en: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to reside there as an alien, for the famine was severe in the land.
text_cn: 其时那地方起了饥荒，亚巴郎遂下到埃及，寄居在那里，因为那地方饥荒十分严重。

text_en: When he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “I know well that you are a woman beautiful in appearance;
text_cn: 当他要进埃及时，对妻子撒辣依说：“我知道你是个貌美的女人；

text_en: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife’; then they will kill me, but they will let you live.
text_cn: 埃及人见了你，必要说：这是他的妻子；他们定要杀我，让你活着。

text_en: Say you are my sister, so that it may go well with me because of you, and that my life may be spared on your account. ”
text_cn: 所以请你说：你是我的妹妹，这样我因了你而必获优待，赖你的情面，保全我的生命。”

text_en: When Abram entered Egypt the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
text_cn: 果然，当亚巴郎一到了埃及，埃及人就注意了这女人实在美丽。

text_en: When the officials of Pharaoh saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh. And the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
text_cn: 法郎的朝臣也看见了她，就在法郎前赞她美丽；这女人就被带入法郎的宫中。

text_en: And for her sake he dealt well with Abram; and he had sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male and female slaves, female donkeys, and camels.
text_cn: 亚巴郎因了她果然蒙了优待，得了些牛羊、公驴、仆婢、母驴和骆驼。

text_en: But the Lord afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
text_cn: 但是，上主为了亚巴郎的妻子撒辣依的事，降下大难打击了法郎和他全家。

text_en: So Pharaoh called Abram, and said, “What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
text_cn: 法郎遂叫亚巴郎来说：“你对我作的是什么事？为什么你没有告诉我，她是你的妻子？

text_en: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister, ’ so that I took her for my wife? Now then, here is your wife, take her, and be gone. ”
text_cn: 为什么你说：她是我的妹妹，以致我娶了她做我的妻子？现在，你的妻子在这里，你带她去罢！”

text_en: And Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning him; and they set him on the way, with his wife and all that he had.
text_cn: 法郎于是吩咐人送走了亚巴郎和他的妻子以及他所有的一切。
